Specification: This module specifies a PlusCal model of an in-place quicksort-style algorithm over arrays of length N whose entries range over 1..N. The algorithm maintains a set S of subarray intervals still to be processed, repeatedly chooses an interval, nondeterministically selects a pivot position, and then nondeterministically replaces the current array by a permutation of itself that satisfies the partition ordering constraints around that pivot. The translated TLA+ specification defines the initial state, a single control-location action qs1, the overall next-state relation, a standard temporal specification with weak fairness on Next, and an eventual termination property asserting that the program counter eventually reaches "Done".
IfThenElse: IF S # {} THEN /\ \E I \in S: IF I[1] < I[2] THEN /\ \E piv \in (I[1])..((I[2])-1): /\ pivot' = piv /\ \E Ap \in {AA \in PermsOf(A) : (\A i \in 1..((I[1])-1) : AA[i] = A[i]) /\ (\A i \in ((I[2])+1)..Len(A) : AA[i] = A[i]) /\ (\A i \in (I[1])..piv, j \in (piv+1)..(I[2]) : AA[i] \leq AA[j])}: A' = Ap /\ S' = (S \ {I}) \cup {<<I[1], pivot'>>, <<pivot'+1, I[2]>>} ELSE /\ S' = (S \ {I}) /\ UNCHANGED << A, pivot >> /\ pc' = "qs1" ELSE /\ pc' = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED << A, S, pivot >>

IF I[1] < I[2] THEN /\ \E piv \in (I[1])..((I[2])-1): /\ pivot' = piv /\ \E Ap \in {AA \in PermsOf(A) : (\A i \in 1..((I[1])-1) : AA[i] = A[i]) /\ (\A i \in ((I[2])+1)..Len(A) : AA[i] = A[i]) /\ (\A i \in (I[1])..piv, j \in (piv+1)..(I[2]) : AA[i] \leq AA[j])}: A' = Ap /\ S' = (S \ {I}) \cup {<<I[1], pivot'>>, <<pivot'+1, I[2]>>} ELSE /\ S' = (S \ {I}) /\ UNCHANGED << A, pivot >>
